requirements.description: Acquire the exact installer from the signed public channel.
Verify Authenticode, timestamp, installer hash, and lineage.
Install on a clean Windows x64 snapshot without developer dependencies.
Launch the installed standalone from the Start menu.
Accept exact public documents and expose operated destinations.
Install or resolve the exact production bank without fixtures or Character dependency.
Create a project with exact settings and bank identity.
Author at least 30 seconds of notes and Japanese lyrics.
Inspect and persist phoneme, unit, pitch, and seam edits.
Hear production sample-concatenative audio for the visible project.
Complete physical WASAPI transport and device-change behavior safely.
Save the project atomically to a selected path.
Reopen with exact bank and materially identical audio.
Recover a dirty project after forced termination without data loss.
Relink a missing or changed bank by exact identity without substitution.
Export a final-quality master WAV.
Export a vocal stem WAV without a partial destination.
Verify exported audio and hashes in an external Windows player.
Complete repair, interrupted update, rollback, uninstall, and reinstall.
Complete stable physical-audio and keyboard/Narrator acceptance.
